arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM results r
          WHERE r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034 AND r.XCL_077 = 1
      )
),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075, COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_077 = 1
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT lt.XCL_044, lt.XCL_043, MIN(lt.XCL_048) AS min_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    INNER JOIN eligible_drivers ed ON lt.XCL_044 = ed.XCL_034
    WHERE lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY lt.XCL_044
)
SELECT 
    ed.XCL_038 AS forename,
    ed.XCL_039 AS surname,
    ed.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    wc.total_wins,
    r.XCL_069 AS race_name
FROM fastest_laps fl
INNER JOIN eligible_drivers ed ON fl.XCL_044 = ed.XCL_034
INNER JOIN win_counts wc ON fl.XCL_044 = wc.XCL_075
INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON fl.XCL_044 = lt.XCL_044 AND fl.XCL_043 = lt.XCL_043 AND fl.min_lap_ms = lt.XCL_048
INNER JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
ORDER BY fl.min_lap_ms ASC
LIMIT 1

          SELECT 1 FROM results r

),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075, COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM results r

    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
),
fastest_laps AS (

)
